topic: Data aggregation and model recalculation for facility changes
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on moving Indian sessions from boxes originally located on 25.04 to new facilities. A key question was whether the data needed to be re-aggregated and if a specific dataset should be used for this process.

It was noted that while the category might remain the same, the model could change because sensors were relocated and an antenna was moved outside. Someone confirmed that a box had been added to the cluster. Consequently, it was determined that the model needed to be recalculated.
decisions: The model must be recalculated due to physical changes (sensor relocation and external antenna installation) at the new facility.
action_items: Someone will restart the process tomorrow when they return from vacation.
